programme.desc: Gordon Returns 1: Gordon revisits three restaurants - Handlebar, Casa Roma and The Black Pearl - to check in with the owners he helped. Has his advice been put to good use?

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Leap Day: Cameron's birthday falls on 29 February, and with the celebrations coming but once every four years, there's loads of pressure on Mitchell to get it right.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Last Walt: Claire supports Luke when his friend Walt dies. Phil takes Alex for some father-daughter bonding time, and Haley throws an unauthorised party.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Great Wife Hope: The male citizens of Springfield become obsessed with the brutal sport of Ultimate Punching, and Marge ends up getting challenged to step into the ring...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Treehouse of Horror XX: Bart and Lisa seek revenge on their teachers. Krusty's latest snack turns Springfield's citizens into zombies. Moe's beer is tainted with Homer's blood.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Devil Wears Nada: Marge becomes famous when she poses for a racy charity calendar. Mr Burns promotes Carl to supervisor.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.: A British secret agent comes to Springfield on the trail of a Russian spy. Guest starring Stephen Fry.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Han Ukkah Solo: When Beverly talks Erica into writing a Hanukkah song for the school holiday concert, she inspires Barry to prove his own musical prowess.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: O Captain! My Captain!: Beverly hopes to inspire the students when she takes over as substitute teacher in Barry's chemistry class. Adam embarrasses Emmy.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Future Dunphys: When Phil takes Claire to the hospital for her angiogram, they meet a family who are basically their future selves. They're not sure they like what they see.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Flip Flop: Phil is confident that he can sell Claire and Cam's renovated house, but when it proves harder than he thought, he resorts to desperate measures.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Career Day: Phil is chuffed to share the wonders of residential real estate with Luke and Manny's classmates for career day, but unfortunately his nemesis, Gil Thorpe, shows up.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: My Hero: Mitch's ex Teddy, a very personable and successful doctor, invites the family to a fundraising event at the local roller rink, where they all run rings around each other.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Star of the Backstage: Marge gets nostalgic about her days as stage manager of her high school play and reunites the cast for a re-run. They say you should never go back...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart's in Jail!: When a phone scammer who's pretending to be Bart fools Grampa into giving away $10,000, it's Homer who's the real victim. According to Homer, anyway.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Treehouse of Horror XXXII: Another Halloween helping of spooky tales, featuring some chilling takes on classic films including Parasite, Nightmare on Elm Street and, er, Bambi.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Judge Me Tender: Moe becomes a judge on American Idol. Meanwhile, Homer spends more time at home, and drives Marge to distraction. Simon Cowell and Ellen DeGeneres guest star.

programme.title: New: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: There's horror in the woods for two McQueens, and tension rises when Kathleen-Angel is caught between her boyfriend and her best friend. Elsewhere, can a couple move past recent events?

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Sabotage: Peralta thinks someone's trying to sabotage his professional life, but Santiago and Diaz aren't convinced. Boyle, Hitchcock and Scully work on a tricky case.

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: Bev dates Howard, a former bank manager with a famous face. And Anthony, who has a wild past, meets Lawrence, who's never been in love and thinks his 'dating river has run dry'.

programme.title: New: Made in Chelsea
programme.desc: Brand new series: With Sam Prince's antics in question, is Arman a better match for Maali? Inga's back and needs Jack's advice on Jazz. And James takes issue with Freddy and Beks.

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: On the box this time: Coronation Street, Love Island, Sex Actually with Alice Levine, Starstruck, Cheat, Dancing on Ice, and Catfish UK.
